product.name: Bayyina
product.tagline: Check a Dubai rent increase against the published rules.

outcome.humanReviewRequired: Needs a person to look at this
outcome.clearHint: The rule settles this on the figures you gave.

disclosure.notAdvice: Information from Dubai's published rental rules, not legal advice.
disclosure.provisional: Our encoding of these rules is pending review by a qualified lawyer, so treat this as information to check, not a ruling.
disclosure.notOfficial: This is not an official determination. Bayyina is not a government entity and does not act for any authority.
disclosure.callerStated: As stated by you. Not independently verified.
disclosure.dataSource: Based on registered tenancy contracts published as open data by Dubai Land Department.

field.currentRent: What you pay now, per year
field.currentRentHelp: The annual rent on your current contract.
field.proposedRentHelp: The annual rent they are asking for.
field.marketAverage: Market average for a similar property

result.heading: Result
result.permitted: That increase is within the published limit.
result.notPermitted: That increase is above the published limit.

status.serviceUnavailable: The service is not reachable right now.

checker.heading: Check a rent increase
checker.intro: Enter the three amounts. We apply Dubai's published rule and show you the clause it comes from.
checker.marketAverageHelp: The average annual rent for a similar property in your area. Enter it from the RERA rental index or your own research — automatic comparables arrive in a later release.

validation.notANumber: Enter an amount in numbers, like 80000.
validation.mustBePositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.

condition.heading: This answer rests on one thing we could not check
condition.market_average_not_derived: You gave us the market average. We applied the rule to that figure exactly, but we have not checked that it is the right average for your property.
condition.thin_comparable_data: We found only {{count}} registered contracts for a property like yours. That is enough to apply the rule, but thinner than we would like.

review.heading: This needs a person to look at it
review.body: We found {{count}} comparable registered contracts — too few to give you a market comparison we can stand behind, so we are not going to quote one.
review.stillTrue: The rule and its source are below. They do not depend on the market comparison.
